name: post-purchase-hub
description: Build tooling for Post-Purchase Hub for WooCommerce.

scripts.env:start: wp-env start && wp-env run tests-cli wp option update woocommerce_feature_custom_order_tables_enabled no && wp-env run tests-cli wp option update woocommerce_custom_orders_table_enabled no
scripts.env:start:hpos: wp-env start --config .wp-env.hpos.json && wp-env run tests-cli --config .wp-env.hpos.json wp option update woocommerce_feature_custom_order_tables_enabled yes && wp-env run tests-cli --config .wp-env.hpos.json wp option update woocommerce_custom_orders_table_enabled yes && wp-env run tests-cli --config .wp-env.hpos.json wp wc update --user=1
